newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING - MAS Technology files 2 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING - MAS Technology files 2 mln shrs.

text.p: MAS Technology Ltd filed Thursday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering of up to two million ordinary shares, it expects to sell between $12 and $14 each.

The Wellington, New Zealand maker of digital microwave radio links for the telecommunications market said underwriters for the offering are Hambrecht & Quist and Oppenheimer & Co Inc. They have an over-allotment option of up to 300,000 shares.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to repay outstanding short-term debt and for working capital and other general corporate needs.
After the offering, the company will have 6.5 million shares outstanding.
For the year eneded March 31, the company reported net income of $2.15 million, or $0.51 a share, on sales of $35.6 million, according to the filing.
